Name: Super Relaxing Egg Bundles
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[size=3][color=#ffff00]eggxactly[/color] what the title says it is: all the bundles in the community center have been edited to be [u][color=#ffff00]eggs[/color] [/u]or [u][color=#ffff00]egg adjacent[/color][/u] items.
[/size]very simple.
[size=3]
this must be downloaded prior to a new save, it will [color=#ffff00]NOT[/color] affect a current save. all prizes are the [color=#ffff00]exact same[/color] as the vanilla game.

most bundles will only require [color=#ffff00]5 regular or large eggs[/color], but some require [color=#ffff00]quality eggs[/color], [color=#ffff00]exotic eggs[/color], or some [color=#ffff00]other egg adjacent items[/color]. there is only one square per bundle, and you can fill it with any of the listed eggs or egg adjacent items. it is mostly very relaxing and you can finish at your pace, but some of the later game bundles will be a bit more [color=#ffff00]challenging[/color]....!

The missing bundle has now been tested! it works just fine! 

[/size]enjoy the egg
